text:
anya: Quick idea — add a /deploy preview flag that auto-generates a release-notes snippet and pins versions used. saves copy/paste.

sam: yes. +1. could be `/deploy preview --notes-from template --pin`

mika: would be nice if it also emits a short rollback decision helper. e.g. if failure rate > X -> auto-suggest rollback steps

lee: We should keep change-window gating too. Something like: `/deploy --window "2026-05-12T22:00Z/2h" --allow-outside false`

ops-sre: Concern: auto-rollback suggestions need human ack. we should add a 'suggested_action' output not automatic.

dev-rel: UX idea: preview creates a markdown blob ready to paste into releases page, includes diffs, pinned hashes, and rollout plan.

sam: rough template:
```
/notes-template
- Summary: {summary}
- Models/services: {services}
- Pinned versions: {pin_list}
- Rollout: {canary_percent} -> {full}
- Rollback plan: {rollback_steps}
```

anya: and the bot could print a compact 'pin-checklist' for reviewers:
```
pin-checklist:
- verify compat matrix
- confirm storage migration free
- confirm schema pin
- signoff @ops-sre
```

deploy-bot: [bot] Generated preview: https://releases.internal/redwood/preview/2077750000 :eyes:

mika: for rollback helper: maybe output suggested commands + TTL to keep rollback available e.g.
```
# suggested rollback
deploy rollback --to 2026-05-10-rc1 --reason "latency spike"
# keep canary route for 15m
```

lee: Also add 'pin-annotation' to git tags so we can query across releases -> `/deploy annotate --tag x.y.z --pin-commit abc123`

ops-sre: If we expose metrics link in preview (errors, p95, cost delta) that would speed decision-making.

dev-rel: small note: keep commands idempotent and outputs human-readable, not just json.

sam: I'll draft a PR with a small library of templates + a new /deploy preview handler. tagging @mika @lee for review.

anya: awesome. can we also add a 'generate-release-notes --from-pr 1234' helper to fetch PR body + changelog heuristics?

mika: yes please. include 'regressions checklist' section.

deploy-bot: [bot] scheduled preview snapshot 2077750450. react with :thumbsup: to promote to staging.

ops-sre: thanks — we'll run through change-window checklist on promote. schedule looks good.

sam: working on PR now. will post link when ready.

anya: thanks all. small follow-up: add tests for pin-checklist generation and ensure drafts don't leak to public releases.

sam: noted. PR will include tests and an example CLI output.
